name: errors
source: OpenCTI-Platform/opencti@c9f5ea5 (opencti-platform/opencti-graphql/src/config/errors.ts and every call of its constructors)
intro: The 659 error messages OpenCTI 7.260811.0-lts.1 can answer to a user or an API client, by the area of the code that raises them. The GraphQL answer carries the message, the error type in `extensions.code` and the data attached in `extensions.data`; `{name}` marks a part computed at run time. Listed: the 18 error types `ACCESS_REQUIRED`, `ALREADY_DELETED_ERROR`, `AUTH_FAILURE`, `AUTH_REQUIRED`, `DATABASE_ERROR`, `DRAFT_LOCKED`, `FORBIDDEN_ACCESS`, `FUNCTIONAL_ERROR`, `LOCK_ERROR`, `LTS_REQUIRED_ACTIVATION`, `MISSING_REFERENCE_ERROR`, `OTP_REQUIRED`, `OTP_REQUIRED_ACTIVATION`, `PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED`, `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `UNSUPPORTED_ERROR`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `WORK_NOT_ALIVE`. Left out: the server failures the code classes as technical with a status 500 (`ComplexSearchError`, `ConfigurationError`, `DatabaseError`, `FilesystemError`, `UnknownError`), the code of startup, migrations, background managers and inference rules (a few of their messages also answer the API, such as applying a rule or running a playbook on an entity), messages held entirely in a variable and developer guards (*unexpected*, *not implemented*, schema registration). Read the platform logs as [Troubleshooting](/deploy/operate/troubleshoot/) explains.
filter: Filter messages, error types and functions

sections.title: Common errors and what to do

rows.key: todo|AUTH_FAILURE|Bad login or password
cells: Check the login and password, or the two-factor code. An account without a local password gets the same message.

rows.key: todo|DRAFT_LOCKED|Cannot execute request in a draft that is not in an open state
cells: Cannot execute request in a draft that is not in an open state
The draft named by the `opencti-draft-id` header is being validated or was validated: send the request outside the draft, or in an open draft.

rows.key: todo|MISSING_REFERENCE_ERROR|Element(s) not found
cells: The input references ids the platform does not know or the user cannot see; `unresolvedIds` in the error data lists them. Create the referenced elements first, or check their markings.

rows.key: todo|LOCK_ERROR|Execution timeout, too many concurrent call on the same entities
cells: Execution timeout, too many concurrent call on the same entities
Other operations hold a lock on the same entities (often several workers updating one container): retry the operation; connectors retry on their own.

rows.key: todo|ACCESS_REQUIRED|Restricted entity already exists, you can request access
cells: Restricted entity already exists, you can request access
An entity with the same identity exists but the user cannot see it; `entityIds` in the error data lists it. Request access to it, as [Request access](/opencti/administer/request-access/) explains.

rows.key: todo|VALIDATION_ERROR|This attribute is mandatory
cells: The input lacks an attribute the entity customization makes mandatory; `field` in the error data names it. Fill it, or change the setting in Settings > Customization.

rows.key: todo|WORK_NOT_ALIVE|Work is no longer alive, no request can be done within the context of this work
cells: Work is no longer alive, no request can be done within the context of this work
The connector work the request belongs to was deleted or is no longer running: start the import again from a new work.

rows.key: todo|FORBIDDEN_ACCESS|You are not allowed to do this.
cells: You are not allowed to do this.

The user lacks the capability the operation requires, or cannot access the element (markings, organization, authorized members). Give the user a group whose role grants the capability, as [Roles and capabilities](/opencti/administer/roles/) explains.

rows.key: todo|OTP_REQUIRED_ACTIVATION|You must activate your account with 2FA.
cells: You must activate your account with 2FA.
The platform makes two-factor authentication mandatory and the user has not set it up yet: set it up when the login screen asks for it.

rows.key: todo|LTS_REQUIRED_ACTIVATION|You must activate your LTS license.
cells: You must activate your LTS license.
This LTS version is blocked until its license is validated: an administrator enters a valid license in Settings.

rows.key: todo|AUTH_REQUIRED|You must be logged in to do this.
cells: You must be logged in to do this.
The request carries no valid credentials: send an `Authorization: Bearer <API token>` header with the token of an active user, or log in again when the browser session has expired.

rows.key: todo|OTP_REQUIRED|You must validate your account with 2FA.
cells: You must validate your account with 2FA.
Two-factor authentication is active for this user: enter the code of the authenticator application to finish the login.
